notes.title: Update Recap – More Fixes, Balance Tweaks, and New Content!
notes.content:
Survivors,

We've been hard at work pushing out updates, and with our latest patch we just released, it's time for a recap of everything we've added and improved! As we shift focus to developing more content, here’s a look at the highlights from our recent updates:

Gameplay & Balance Tweaks
Character Balance & Upgrades:

Marksman remains the top single-target damage dealer but now has more AOE upgrade options.

Samurai saw minor nerfs and upgrade adjustments to support varied playstyles.

Robot was heavily nerfed (he was way too OP).

Biomancer received slight buffs but still focuses on supporting and buffing allies rather than raw damage.

Secondary Weapon Overhaul: Unique max-rank upgrades have been reduced to one per weapon. The more interesting ones have been turned into Modules or integrated into earlier upgrades.

Reworked Toxic Horror Boss Fight: The randomly moving poison clouds have been removed. Instead, a single large cloud will slowly fill the entire arena. The cloud resets only when all minions enter their shield state, making the boss vulnerable to damage. This change prevents players from getting stuck in an unwinnable state, dragging the fight out unnecessarily. If you don’t have enough DPS or speed, the cloud will ensure a quicker failure rather than wasting minutes in a hopeless battle.

New Content & Features

 5 New Modules
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/1b66af043b0c4093c47dfb6b1631a6bec3c2b787.png
 Task Markers Helpful arrows and map markers have been added to the Robot unlock quest, making progression clearer.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/4e92b1245bc62c489a4562dd7ea676f6e0db174b.png
 More Detailed Damage Stats Now in the inventory screen, this detailed breakdown of damage will let you track how well your build is performing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/7a964cb76d9ae14456755d1954e04c85784db69b.png


UI & Quality of Life Improvements

 Updated NPC Menus: Garret's character upgrade screen and Oliver's upgrade tree viewer have been updated for better controller navigation.

 Tooltip Refinements: Improved placement so tooltips don’t block buttons or get covered by the cursor.


New Analytics Tools
Players will now be prompted to opt-in to anonymous data collection, which will help us fine-tune balance and progression. No personal info—just gameplay stats like death locations, level progression, and upgrade usage. This will be a huge help in shaping the game’s future!

Bug Fixes & More
Countless bug fixes and optimizations to improve stability and performance.

With this wave of updates out, we’re now shifting focus toward developing new content! Thanks for playing, and as always, we appreciate your feedback and support.

See you in the void!

notes.title: First Week Patch Roundup!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s been an exciting first week since the demo launched, and we can’t thank you enough for playing, sharing feedback, and helping us improve Eldritch Escape! We’ve been hard at work making adjustments based on your thoughts, and we wanted to highlight some of the key changes we’ve made this week.

Here’s what’s new:

Reworked Squad Select Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/55e079df3f7b22fa3a5deb8183180bf4f5923d42.png
We gave the squad select screen a major overhaul! It now presents information more clearly, with improved controller flow and support, making it easier to build your dream squad.

Updated Meta Progression Menu (The Doctor)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/3e25291c7fb25263c42e1ddf91495ec2e6b4bc82.png
This one’s more of a polish pass than a full rework, but we focused on improving controller feel and smoothing out interactions when spending points with Dr. Thorne.

All-New Tooltip System

We rebuilt the tooltip system from the ground up! You can now scale tooltip size in the gameplay settings to match your preferences and controllers no longer need to press the left thumbstick to bring up tooltips. We’re still ironing out the kinks, but it’s already a good step forward.

Looted A Duplicate Module? No Problem!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/bba9f5ae8e578489b0840e338c0da1c76f902905.png
When you pick up a duplicate module, a new inventory popup will explain how it combines with the one you already have. It also shows a comparison between the old and upgraded versions. We're working on a fallback system too, so if you loot a duplicate for a fully upgraded module, you won’t walk away empty-handed.

Balance Tweaks & Difficulty Tuning

Based on your feedback, we’ve made the early game a bit more forgiving while turning up the heat in the late game. We’re aiming for a smoother difficulty curve so everyone has a fun and challenging experience.

Bug Fixes Galore

We’ve squashed a ton of bugs and made plenty of under-the-hood improvements to keep things running smoothly.

Keep the Feedback Coming!
We’re grateful for all the feedback so far—it’s been a huge help in shaping the game. If you enjoyed your time with the demo, please consider leaving a Steam review—it really helps us out!

And if you haven’t tried the demo yet… what are you waiting for? Jump in, slay some monsters, and see if you can outlast certain players who think the game’s too hard. 😉

notes.title: Eldritch Escape Demo is out now!
notes.content:
The wait is over! The Eldritch Escape Demo has officially launched, and we can’t wait for you to dive in, battle through the horrors of the void, and (hopefully) make it out alive.

We’re a small team, and your feedback means everything to us. If you run into bugs, have suggestions, or just want to share your experience, you can report issues directly in-game through the Feedback button or drop us a message in the Steam forums. Every bit of feedback helps us improve and expand the game!

What’s Next?

While the game is fully playable, we already have some exciting new features in the works—so before you ask, yes, we’re already working on:

More Characters, Worlds, Modules, Weapons, Enemies, and Bosses – Let’s get the most obvious one out of the way. Yes, we have a whole roster of new survivors in the works, along with strange new worlds, terrifying enemies, and eldritch bosses ruled by the other Great Old Ones.
Detailed Damage & Post-Run Summaries – We’re expanding the information available during and after a run, giving you better insight into your builds, damage output, and overall strategy so you can refine your approach.
Better Introduction & Onboarding – The void is a confusing place, but we’re working on making it a little easier to navigate. Expect more quests and expanded NPC dialogue to help introduce players to the world, its mechanics, and its many lurking horrors.
Better Menu UX & Controller Support – While Eldritch Escape is fully playable with a controller, we know some menus can be, frankly, a pain to navigate. We’re in the process of revamping them for a smoother and more intuitive experience.
Localization – We want as many people as possible to enjoy EE, so localization is on our roadmap! We’ve already laid the groundwork for a seamless translation system to bring the game to more languages in the future.

This is just the start of Eldritch Escape, and we’re incredibly grateful to have you all along for the ride. Thank you for playing, wishlisting, and supporting us—we couldn’t do this without you! Oh, and if you’ve got a Steam Deck? Eldritch Escape runs great on it—so don’t forget to take the void with you on the go!

Now get out there and fight for your survival.

notes.title: Eldritch Escape Demo Arrives February 14th!💀
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/b3badb650d6e896398f67253fcbf2f51b1baf67c.png
Valentine’s Day is a time for love, warmth, and… horrific eldritch nightmares? Forget the chocolates—this Friday, February 14th, we’re unleashing the Eldritch Escape demo!

Our two-person team has been working tirelessly to deliver a polished, action-packed demo that gives you a true taste of what’s to come. Full controller support? Check. Steam Deck ready? You bet. Localization into other languages?.........still working on that one, sorry. 



What Awaits You?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/10bceddf616c9811772257690eb1fed1def20683.png
Enter Shub-Niggurath’s forsaken garden, a world where sentient plant creatures are greedily feasting their way into a bountiful 'spring.' Unfortunately, humanity is now part of the food chain—putting a whole new, horrifying twist on 'you are what you eat.'



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280759/af3227c4d7ea42df8d055d818e2f2176d5c87188.png
Three survivors step up to the challenge… but there’s a hidden fourth waiting to be unlocked. Steel and circuitry weren’t meant to survive in the void. And yet… something has awakened. Was it always meant to think? Or did the void change it?

This Valentine’s Day, let love rot and embrace the void. Wishlist Eldritch Escape now and prepare to fight for survival this Friday!

notes.title: Bullet Heaven 2.0 Fest!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that Eldritch Escape will be part of our very first Steam Fest, the Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0! This marks an exciting milestone for us, and we can’t wait to share what we’ve been working on with all of you.

🔥 STREAM WITH THE DEVS 🔥
Get ready to dive into the dark and chaotic world of Eldritch Escape! Join us for our first-ever live stream, where we’ll showcase the heart-pounding, bullet-hell action and reveal some of the unique systems and mechanics that make Eldritch Escape stand out in the genre.

During the stream, we’ll be answering your questions, talking about the inspirations and design philosophies behind the game, and giving you a sneak peek into the gameplay that will leave you on the edge of your seat. Don’t miss it—this is your chance to connect with us directly and see the game in action!

📢 PUBLIC DEMO COMING IN JANUARY 📢
While we’re beyond excited to participate in Bullet Heaven Fest 2.0, we’ve made the decision not to release a demo just yet. Why? Because we want your first experience with Eldritch Escape to be unforgettable, and we’re taking the extra time to fine-tune everything to perfection. First impressions matter, and we’re determined to deliver something truly special.

The wait won’t be long though! We’re thrilled to announce that the public demo will launch in January 2025. Start your new year with a bang by stepping into the void, battling eldritch horrors, and uncovering the mysteries of Eldritch Escape.

Make sure to wishlist the game, follow our Steam page, and keep an eye on our socials for updates. We can’t wait to share more with you soon. See you in the stream!
